symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1515 item 3: "a lone \ in replaceAll was stored as an unterminated or wrong regex and failed at runtime ('Failed to evaluate expression'); a JSON escape needs the 4-backslash and 8-backslash forms because replaceAll is a regex replace". Asked: warn on a replacement whose backslash escapes nothing.
cause: Half the premise is wrong. The Mendix runtime's replaceAll/replaceFirst (10.24.24, 11.13.0, 11.15.0) is text.replaceAll(regex, Matcher.quoteReplacement(replacement)), and the nanoflow client escapes `$` before String.replace: the REPLACEMENT is literal text, so '\' or '$1' there is inserted as written. Only the PATTERN is a regex, and one ending in a lone backslash builds (mx check 11.13.0: 0 errors) and throws PatternSyntaxException "Unescaped trailing backslash" on every call (client: "\ at end of pattern"); isMatch too. The 4/8-backslash forms are mdl 0's `\\` = one backslash applied to the correct 2/4.
file: `mdl/exprcheck/regex_backslash.go` (TrailingBackslashRegexes), `mdl/executor/validate_regex_backslash.go` (MDL-REGEX01 warning, from checkExprFunctions so microflows and nanoflows share it); `cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_microflow.go` (new microflow.expressions topic); tests `mdl/exprcheck/regex_backslash_test.go`, `mdl/executor/validate_regex_backslash_test.go`; fixture `mdl-examples/bug-tests/regex-backslash-1397-replaceall.mdl`
insight: Settle a runtime-semantics claim by CALLING the runtime, not by reasoning about Java: mxbuild ships the runtime jars, and com.mendix.languages.expressions.StringFunctions$/DateTimeFunctions$ can be driven from a ten-line Java program (classpath: mxruntime, internal-public-api, public-api, scala-library, scala3-library; a java.lang.reflect.Proxy EvaluationContext answering mathContext/locale is enough). `javap -c` on the anon class showed Matcher.quoteReplacement before any run. The same probe settled the issue's aside: millisecondsBetween..weeksBetween return the ABSOLUTE difference on the server (11.13/11.15) and the client (`.sub().abs().div()` in mxui.js). What is stored also needs measuring, not assuming: `mxcli bson dump` shows mdl 1 stores a literal as written and mdl 0 halves `\\`, so the check judges the stored text (microflowExprSource), which makes one rule correct under both headers. Item 2 (toString(Decimal) into a bounded String attribute) was not done: attribute values are ResolveBy:AttributeOf slots nothing enforces, and no tier knows an attribute's String length — the catalog reader has kind but not length, and the no-project tier tracks no script entities.
